threat_event: Business email compromise: a Project Manager's mailbox is taken over through an adversary-in-the-middle phishing page and used to send an owner a 'new remittance' letter, so a progress payment goes to the attacker
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push MFA is not phishing-resistant for Project Managers; private owners have not been told how remittance changes are confirmed; DMARC at quarantine with no lookalike-domain monitoring; SYS-01 and mailbox audit logs only partly monitored
existing_controls: Push MFA with number matching; external-sender banner; payment-fraud training; MSSP alerts on inbox forwarding rules
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for Project Managers, billing, accounts payable, and executives; remittance-change letter to all 22 owners and in every pay app cover sheet; lookalike-domain monitoring; DMARC reject; SYS-01 audit logs to the SIEM
exposure_estimate_usd: $0.5M-$2.5M per event (one pay app averages $1.2M; social engineering sublimit $1M)

threat_event: A spoofed or compromised subcontractor email requests a bank-account change that is entered in the ERP vendor master, diverting a progress payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Call-back verification bypassed for 'urgent' requests (2 of 25 sampled changes); vendor-master change log not in the SIEM; daily change review skipped when the Controller is out
existing_controls: Second approver for vendor-master changes; dual ACH approval; call-back rule since 2025; positive pay
treatment_plan: Remove the urgent override; call-back evidence field required before approval; backup reviewer for the daily change report; vendor-master change alerts to the SIEM; 10-day hold on first payment to changed accounts above $50,000

threat_event: CUI for FC-4 is handled outside the enclave (1,140 items in the commercial project platform, offline sets on 26 tablets, unsecured printed sets) and is disclosed to unauthorized people or found by DoD, leading to a reportable incident and contract action
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CUI flows not technically restricted; FC-4 folder template grants read to 230 external users; tablets hold offline sets; no CUI handling rules for the trailer; no role-based CUI training for field staff
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; SYS-09 (26 tablets); SYS-07; FC-4 trailer; BP-04
existing_controls: CPE exists with FedRAMP-authorized services; Government drawings arrive marked; locked plan cabinet installed 2026-08-20
treatment_plan: Remove CUI from SYS-01 and tablets and assess the spill under DFARS 252.204-7012(c)(1)(i); CPE workflow for CUI RFIs and submittals; field access through virtual desktops on managed tablets; printed CUI rules; CUI training for FC-4 staff and trades
exposure_estimate_usd: $1M-$6M (FC-4 cure or termination exposure, loss of the follow-on MATOC, investigation and legal costs)

threat_event: CUI is stolen from an FC-4 subcontractor (the A&E firm or a trade) that has no DFARS flowdown, no verified SPRS score, and no duty to tell the company
threat_source: Cybercriminal or nation-state actor targeting defense facility data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Only the A&E subcontract has DFARS 252.204-7012; 3 of 15 SPRS scores verified; no incident-number duty in 14 trade subcontracts
existing_controls: A&E subcontract includes the clause; guest accounts in the CPE for 8 A&E staff
treatment_plan: Flow down DFARS 252.204-7012 to the 14 trades by modification; verify SPRS scores; send CUI only through the CPE or to verified systems; add incident-number duty
exposure_estimate_usd: $500K-$3M (incident response support, contract action, reputational loss with the Army Corps)

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts corporate endpoints, file shares, and cloud workloads and steals data, halting bidding, billing, payroll, and field document flow
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push MFA for general users; 7 jobsite routers with internet-facing administration; privileged access management only in the cloud; no company copy of SYS-01 and SYS-02 data
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04; SYS-05; SYS-06; SYS-08; SYS-09; BP-01 to BP-16
sp800_53_controls: CP-9; CP-10; CP-4; AC-6; SC-7; SI-4
existing_controls: EDR with 24x7 MSSP; immutable backups in a separate account and region; MFA; quarterly scanning
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA; router baseline; privileged access management for SaaS administrators; nightly SYS-01 and SYS-02 exports; ransomware tabletop 2027-02
exposure_estimate_usd: $1.5M-$4M (outage, response, a possible missed bid; insurance limit $10M)

threat_event: Employee personal information (Social Security numbers, bank accounts, certified payroll records) is stolen from the payroll SaaS or HR files, requiring notice under Fla. Stat. 501.171
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HR exports on file shares; payroll self-service uses push MFA
existing_controls: Payroll vendor SOC 2; MFA; encryption at rest
treatment_plan: Remove HR exports from shares; restrict payroll admin roles; breach decision steps in P08
exposure_estimate_usd: $300K-$900K (about 600 employees and former employees notified; counsel; credit monitoring)

threat_event: The company is not CMMC Level 2 (C3PAO) certified when the follow-on MATOC is awarded (about 2027-07) and is ineligible for about 15% of planned revenue
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 45 SP 800-171 requirements not fully met; CUI outside the enclave; recalculated score -23 (P03); small security team; the USACE Level 2 (C3PAO) requirement is suspended with CMMC Phase 2, but the MATOC may still require Level 2 (Self), and SP 800-171 Rev. 2 under DFARS 252.204-7012 still applies
existing_controls: CPE built; policies; quarterly audit committee reporting
treatment_plan: P03 roadmap; readiness check by internal audit 2027-03; voluntary C3PAO assessment 2027-04-12 to 2027-04-23; funded in FY2027
exposure_estimate_usd: $15M-$20M of revenue at risk over the MATOC term (about $3M-$4M a year)

threat_event: The SPRS score of 71 or a future CMMC affirmation overstates implementation, creating False Claims Act and contract exposure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2025 score assumed CUI stayed in the enclave; no independent check of the calculation before posting
existing_controls: General Counsel reviews federal representations
treatment_plan: Post the corrected score (-23) by 2026-09-30 with counsel review; internal audit reperforms each score; the CEO affirms only against an evidence binder
exposure_estimate_usd: $1M-$10M (False Claims Act damages and penalties scale with contract value; legal costs)

threat_event: A cyber incident affecting CUI is not reported to DoD within 72 hours because no one holds a valid medium assurance certificate and the process has never been exercised
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Only certificate expired 2026-05-20; no CUI incident exercise; FC-4 Project Executive not trained on reporting
existing_controls: POL-03 names the duty; P08 notification matrix
treatment_plan: Two certificates (Director of Contracts and Compliance, Security Manager); CUI incident tabletop with a DIBNet drill 2026-11-18

threat_event: Covered telecommunications or video surveillance equipment is provided on a federal job through a private-label product or substitution
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Submittal screening relies on brand names; no OEM confirmation for private-label cameras and recorders
existing_controls: Submittal screening for federal jobs since 2025; approved-manufacturer list
treatment_plan: Written OEM confirmation for every camera, recorder, and network switch on federal jobs; distributor attestation in purchase orders
owner: Director of Technology and Security Systems
exposure_estimate_usd: $100K-$500K per job (replacement at company cost, schedule impact)

threat_event: An internet-facing jobsite cellular router is taken over and used to intercept traffic or reach tablets and laptops in the trailer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 7 of 22 routers expose remote administration to the internet; no baseline; firmware not tracked; not logged centrally
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-08 jobsite routers; SYS-09; BP-03; BP-07
existing_controls: Routers use carrier cellular service; SaaS traffic uses TLS
treatment_plan: Close remote administration now; replace with centrally managed routers and a baseline; logs to the SIEM

threat_event: An unmanaged rugged tablet is lost or stolen with offline drawing sets (FCI; CUI on FC-4)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 40 tablets outside device management; no remote wipe; offline sets cached
existing_controls: Tablets need a project platform sign-in
treatment_plan: Enroll or retire the 40 tablets; block offline sync for unmanaged devices

threat_event: A SYS-01 company-administrator account held by a Project Manager is taken over and used to export all project data or change pay app workflow approvers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 Project Managers hold company-administrator rights; SYS-01 audit logs not monitored
existing_controls: SSO with MFA
treatment_plan: Reduce SYS-01 administrators to 3 IT staff; project-level admin roles for PMs; SYS-01 audit log collection

threat_event: A departing estimator or Project Manager takes bid, pricing, and subcontractor bid data to a competitor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Broad read access to the estimating database; no download alerts
existing_controls: Confidentiality agreements; access removed at termination
treatment_plan: Download volume alerts; role-based access by region; exit checklist with data return attestation

threat_event: The estimating database is unavailable in bid week and a major bid is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single database instance; bid-week exports are not routine
existing_controls: Restore tested 2026-03 (2 hours); daily backups
treatment_plan: Prior-day export on an encrypted laptop during bid weeks; bid-week change freeze

threat_event: A targeted attacker uses a stolen enclave session to stage and steal CUI, and the activity is not detected because CPE logs are reviewed weekly by hand
threat_source: Nation-state actor targeting defense facility data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CPE logs not in any monitoring service; no correlation with corporate sign-ins; 180-day retention
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant MFA; separate tenant; FedRAMP-authorized services
treatment_plan: Monitoring service in the government-community cloud with 24x7 alerting; 1-year retention; correlation rules for corporate and enclave identities
exposure_estimate_usd: $1M-$5M (incident response, DoD damage assessment support, loss of eligibility)

threat_event: CUI design packages in the CPE are lost through deletion, a synchronization error, or a compromised account, with no independent backup
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CPE relies on provider versioning and retention only
existing_controls: Provider versioning (93 days)
treatment_plan: Backup service in the same government-community cloud with separate administrator credentials; quarterly restore test

threat_event: An ERP outage in billing week exceeds the 48-hour MTD because the vendor's RTO is 24 hours outside priority support
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ERP vendor RTO is 24 hours; no billing-week priority clause in the contract
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 report; manual pay app workaround
treatment_plan: Billing-week priority support in the 2027 renewal; daily schedule of values and job cost export
exposure_estimate_usd: $60K plus up to $7.8M cash delayed one cycle

threat_event: The project platform tenant or a project administrator account is lost or corrupted and the company has no copy of its project records
threat_source: SaaS vendor failure or account compromise
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No company-controlled export of SYS-01 project records
existing_controls: Vendor backups (RTO 4 hours, RPO 1 hour)
treatment_plan: Nightly API export of project records to the backup account

threat_event: The MBSS monitoring platform is down longer than the 4-hour MTD and client security alarms go unanswered
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single cloud region; full rebuild never tested
existing_controls: Daily backups; single region
treatment_plan: Templates and runbook for rebuild in a second region; tested by 2027-03-31
owner: Director of Technology and Security Systems

threat_event: An attacker uses MBSS remote access (shared technician accounts at 11 sites) to take control of a client's access control or cameras
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 11 of 38 sites reached through client tools with shared accounts; no session recording at those sites
existing_controls: Company gateway with named accounts and recording at 27 sites; credential vault
treatment_plan: Move all 11 sites to the company gateway or named client accounts; quarterly access review with each client
owner: Director of Technology and Security Systems
exposure_estimate_usd: $500K-$3M (client harm, liability, loss of the MBSS line)

threat_event: Client facility security details (camera layouts, controller credentials) are stolen from the credential vault or from old project files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Old commissioning spreadsheets still in 2023-2024 project folders
existing_controls: Vault with check-out approval since 2025
treatment_plan: Search and purge old spreadsheets; rotate credentials found
owner: Director of Technology and Security Systems

threat_event: Stale external accounts (31 on closed projects) or departed A&E guests are used to read drawings
threat_source: Former subcontractor staff or attacker using reused passwords
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Closeout removal not done; A&E departures not reported
existing_controls: Semiannual reviews
treatment_plan: Closeout checklist removes external users; quarterly reviews; A&E departure notice in the subcontract

threat_event: A terminated field employee keeps access for days after leaving
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Superintendents enter terminations late (3 of 25 sampled late)
existing_controls: Automatic disable once HR enters the termination
treatment_plan: Same-day termination entry from the time-clock system; weekly reconciliation

threat_event: A federal payment is diverted after an unauthorized change to the company's EFT data in SAM
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SAM Entity Administrator role held by one person; no alert on SAM changes
existing_controls: SAM sign-in through the government sign-in service with MFA
treatment_plan: Two Entity Administrators; SAM changes need CFO approval; monthly SAM record check

threat_event: Employees' direct-deposit details are changed through phished payroll self-service accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Payroll self-service uses push MFA; bank changes take effect next cycle
existing_controls: Email confirmation of bank changes to the employee
treatment_plan: Bank changes take effect after a call-back from payroll staff

threat_event: A critical SaaS vendor (project platform, ERP, or payroll) is compromised and attackers reach many customers' data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Concentration in a few SaaS vendors; reliance on SOC 2 reports
existing_controls: Annual SOC 2 review of 9 critical vendors
treatment_plan: Exports (R-019); breach notice terms in contracts; tier vendors (R-028)

threat_event: A vendor with data access is breached and the company does not learn of it quickly because about 210 vendors are not tiered or monitored
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No vendor tiering; reviews only at onboarding for most vendors
existing_controls: SOC 2 review of 9 SaaS vendors
treatment_plan: Tier all vendors; annual review of Tier 1; notice clauses

threat_event: The productivity suite AI assistant (AI-003) surfaces overshared FCI or bid data to users who should not see it, or a user pastes CUI into it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Enabled for all users 2026-04 without review; overshared sites; CUI rule not taught
existing_controls: Suite permissions; AI-003 does not reach the CPE
treatment_plan: Restrict AI-003 to reviewed groups until oversharing is fixed; sensitivity labels; training (P10)

threat_event: The AI estimating and bid assistant (AI-001) produces wrong quantities or prices that are not caught, and the company wins a loss-making bid
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Quantity takeoff accuracy not validated by trade; no review checklist
existing_controls: Senior estimator review of every bid
treatment_plan: Accuracy testing by trade; mandatory variance review against historical costs (P10)

threat_event: Jobsite safety video analytics (AI-002) capture worker images without notice and are used for discipline in ways workers did not expect
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written notice to workers; retention not set
existing_controls: Vendor contract
treatment_plan: Written notice at sites; purpose limited to safety coaching; 30-day retention (P10)

threat_event: The applicant screening feature (AI-006) ranks applicants in a way that has adverse impact on a protected group
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Enabled by vendor default; no adverse impact analysis
existing_controls: Recruiters review all applicants today
treatment_plan: Turn off ranking until an adverse impact analysis is done (P10)

threat_event: AI invoice capture (AI-004) reads changed remittance details from a fraudulent invoice and they flow into payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Extracted bank fields could update the vendor record without the call-back step
existing_controls: Vendor-master changes need a second approver
treatment_plan: Block AI-004 from writing to bank fields; flag invoices whose remittance differs from the vendor master (P10)

threat_event: MBSS alarm triage (AI-005) suppresses a real critical alarm as noise
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Suppression rules tuned by the vendor model without company sign-off
existing_controls: Technicians see all critical alarms for door forced and controller offline
treatment_plan: Weekly review of suppressed alarms; no suppression of critical classes (P10)
owner: Director of Technology and Security Systems

threat_event: The internet-facing file-transfer portal or another cloud server is exploited through an unpatched flaw
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Quarterly scanning; portal in a public subnet with one sync path
existing_controls: Public subnet; EDR; monthly patching
treatment_plan: Monthly scanning; web application firewall for the portal

threat_event: An internet or power outage at headquarters stops the MBSS monitoring room
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One monitoring room at headquarters
existing_controls: Second internet circuit; generator; technicians can monitor from laptops
treatment_plan: Accepted: existing redundancy is within appetite; review yearly

threat_event: A hurricane damages headquarters, the yard, and jobsites and cuts power and connectivity for days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Florida location; trailers and the yard are exposed; jobsite connectivity is cellular only
affected_asset_or_process: All sites; BP-03; BP-07; BP-09; BP-11
existing_controls: SaaS and cloud hosting outside the region; hurricane plan for jobsites
treatment_plan: Add IT and MBSS steps to the hurricane plan; pre-staged laptops at the regional office

threat_event: Printed CUI is lost in transit between the A&E office, headquarters, and the FC-4 jobsite
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No transport rule; sets not numbered
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Numbered sets; sealed transport; sign-out log

threat_event: An unauthorized visitor at the FC-4 trailer views or photographs CUI drawings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Trailer open to all trades during the day; visitor log incomplete (14 of 41 July visitors missing)
existing_controls: Installation gate control
treatment_plan: Separate CUI room in the trailer with badge lock; visitor log reconciled weekly with gate records

threat_event: An attacker calls the help desk posing as a Project Manager and gets MFA reset, then takes over the mailbox
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Help desk verifies identity with employee ID and manager name only
existing_controls: Help desk script
treatment_plan: Video verification or in-person reset for payment roles and executives

threat_event: A lookalike domain impersonates the company to send fake bid invitations or payment instructions to owners and subcontractors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No lookalike-domain monitoring; DMARC at quarantine
existing_controls: DMARC quarantine; SPF; DKIM
treatment_plan: Lookalike-domain monitoring service; DMARC reject; takedown procedure

threat_event: Known flaws persist on enclave laptops and jobsite routers because they are not scanned
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Quarterly scanning excludes enclave laptops and routers
existing_controls: Automatic OS updates
treatment_plan: Monthly authenticated scans including enclave laptops; router firmware tracking

threat_event: A change to the enclave virtual desktop image allows clipboard or download, letting CUI leave the enclave
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Image changes approved but no CUI data-movement test
existing_controls: Change board
treatment_plan: Data-movement test in every image change

threat_event: FC-4 field staff and trade personnel mishandle CUI because they were never trained
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No role-based CUI training for field staff or trades
existing_controls: 2025 briefing for office staff
treatment_plan: Annual CUI training for all CPE users and FC-4 field staff; trade foremen briefing

threat_event: A compromised commissioning laptop spreads malware into a client building system during installation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Commissioning laptops managed since 2025 but used on client networks
existing_controls: EDR on commissioning laptops
treatment_plan: Dedicated commissioning image; no email or browsing
owner: Director of Technology and Security Systems

threat_event: A telematics or time-clock vendor breach exposes equipment locations or time records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor-operated; limited data
existing_controls: Vendor contracts
treatment_plan: Accepted: low data sensitivity; review at renewal

threat_event: A retired tablet or router is disposed of without sanitization
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Field devices not always returned to IT
existing_controls: Certified destruction vendor for laptops
treatment_plan: Field device return checklist; destruction certificates

threat_event: A planned add-on acquisition brings an unassessed contractor network into the company
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No security due diligence step in the acquisition process
existing_controls: Due diligence led by the CFO
treatment_plan: Security due diligence checklist; no connection until assessed

threat_event: Loss of a key member of the 4-person security team or the vCISO delays the CMMC roadmap
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Small team; part-time vCISO; key-person dependence
existing_controls: Documented procedures; co-sourced audit firm
treatment_plan: Add one security analyst for the CPE; retention agreements; cross-training

threat_event: Project records needed for claims, disputes, or federal audits cannot be produced
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Records spread across SYS-01, email, and file shares
existing_controls: Payroll vendor retention; SYS-01 retention
treatment_plan: Accepted: records exist in vendor systems; export (R-019) reduces it further

threat_event: Rented jobsite cameras at the FC-2 federal courthouse jobsite are covered video surveillance equipment, used for security of a Government facility (found in P07 on 2026-08-12)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Rented jobsite equipment was outside Section 889 screening; vendor's private-label cameras not checked
existing_controls: Reported to the Contracting Officer 2026-08-13; follow-up 2026-08-26; cameras removed 2026-08-14
treatment_plan: Section 889 check for all rented and leased equipment; written confirmation from every jobsite technology vendor; SAM representation review by counsel

threat_event: A guest account of a departed A&E employee stayed active in the CPE for 47 days (found in P07 on 2026-08-19)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: A&E departures not reported; CPE reviews semiannual
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant MFA on the account (key returned)
treatment_plan: Disabled 2026-08-19; monthly A&E roster reconciliation; 30-day guest expiry
